notes.title: Update Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Version 1.0.1 Update

New Features

Added draggable camera rotation

Added running (with stamina limit)

Added ESC key to exit the menu

Bug Fixes

Building collision issues

Main menu disappearing

Suicide-related bug

Water not displaying

Buildings disappearing

NPCs invading player homes

Items potentially disappearing

Quest Fixes

Bug in the "Loud Noise After Robinson Enters the House" quest

Bug in the "Employee Workhouse" quest

Gameplay Adjustments

Enlarged minimap, added edge icon indicators, and adjusted map rotation behavior

Reduced tree animation intensity
